items.title: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey introduces ElastiCache Insights
items.blurb: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey now features ElastiCache Insights, a pre-built dashboard in Amazon CloudWatch for your node-based clusters.

items.title: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports index-level encryption
items.blurb: Amazon OpenSearch Service now supports index-level encryption, letting you encrypt each index at rest with its own AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) customer managed key.

items.title: AWS Transfer Family supports custom ports for public SFTP servers
items.blurb: AWS Transfer Family now lets you configure custom ports on public SFTP servers and choose a communication mode for each port. You can support clients that require different ports or start SFTP connections differently on a single server.

items.title: AWS Secrets Manager adds managed external secrets support for Databricks and Twilio
items.blurb: AWS Secrets Manager now extends its managed external secrets capability to include Databricks and Twilio, enabling you to automatically rotate the credentials that your data pipelines and messaging applications use to call these services.
